parts.text:
Done. `POST /v1/orders` now runs a per-API-key fixed-window limiter (60/min) registered as `app.rateLimit(...)` in a new `src/plugins/rateLimit.js`; the 61st call in a window gets `429` with `Retry-After` in seconds. All four order tests pass, including a new one for the 429 path.

One caveat: the counter is in-process. If orbit-api ever runs more than one instance behind the load balancer, the bucket needs to move to Redis — I left a note in the plugin.

parts.text: Root cause: the test used real timers. With `backoffMs: 50` the three real waits plus jitter add up to 350–500 ms, and on a loaded CI runner that occasionally crossed the 500 ms default test timeout. The fix is to make `deliver()` take injectable `sleep` and `jitter` functions (production defaults unchanged) so the test records the intended back-off schedule (`[50, 100, 200]`) instead of actually waiting. 20 consecutive runs green.
